# Florida FR-44 Auto Insurance

> Florida FR-44 Auto Insurance helps drivers across Florida get fast, affordable FR-44, SR-22, DUI, and standard auto insurance quotes by comparing multiple licensed carriers, including Allstate and National General. Texting is the fastest way to reach the team.

Florida FR-44 Auto Insurance is an independent insurance agency led by licensed Allstate agent Matt Saffian (Florida Resident License #G273626), not an insurance carrier itself. The agency compares rates across multiple Florida-licensed carriers — including Allstate and National General, an Allstate company — to find affordable coverage for drivers with FR-44 or SR-22 requirements, DUI convictions, high-risk driving records, no prior insurance, or no driving experience. The site is text-first: most customer contact happens by SMS rather than phone calls or in-person visits.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://floridafr44autoinsurance.com/): Overview of services, statewide Florida coverage, and quote request.
- [Get a Free Quote](https://floridafr44autoinsurance.com/quote/): Request a free FR-44, SR-22, or standard auto insurance quote.
- [FR-44 Insurance](https://floridafr44autoinsurance.com/fr44-insurance/): Comprehensive overview of FR-44 insurance in Florida.
- [SR-22 Insurance](https://floridafr44autoinsurance.com/sr22-insurance/): Explanation of SR-22 requirements and how they differ from FR-44.
- [Florida Auto Insurance](https://floridafr44autoinsurance.com/florida-auto-insurance/): Breakdown of Florida auto insurance coverage types.
- [Guides](https://floridafr44autoinsurance.com/guides/): 18 long-form pillar guides on FR-44, SR-22, DUI, high-risk insurance, and more.
- [Blog](https://floridafr44autoinsurance.com/blog/): 89+ searchable, filterable articles across six categories (see below).
- [FAQ](https://floridafr44autoinsurance.com/faq/): 30+ frequently asked questions about FR-44, SR-22, and working with the agency.
- [About](https://floridafr44autoinsurance.com/about/): Agency mission, agent bio, and carrier affiliations.
- [Contact](https://floridafr44autoinsurance.com/contact/): Text, email, and service area — no phone-only support.

## Blog (searchable and filterable by category)

The blog at /blog/ includes a search bar and category filter pills. Categories:

- **FR-44 Basics** — how FR-44 works, filing process, requirements, certificates, coverage limits, quotes
- **SR-22 Basics** — how SR-22 works, filing process, requirements, certificates, coverage limits, quotes, payment plans
- **DUI Insurance** — coverage after first/second/multiple DUIs, finding carriers, affordability
- **Cost & Rates** — lowering premiums, discounts, comparing quotes, payment plans, credit score questions
- **Policies** — no prior insurance, no driving experience/history, license suspension/revocation, lapses, denied-coverage troubleshooting, non-owner insurance, choosing an agent
- **Florida Auto Insurance** — general Florida coverage requirements and driving laws

City-specific FR-44/SR-22 coverage pages exist for Miami, Orlando, Tampa, Jacksonville, Melbourne, Port St. Lucie, Vero Beach, and Palm Bay.
